name: Trophy Swoop Quill
summary: Across Mulgore, swoops circle above the plains, and their quills mark a hunter’s skill. Tauren bring these feathers to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.

sections.title: Token of the Hunt
sections.body: Swoops ride high above Mulgore’s grasslands, where they are hard to track. Young tauren hunters and travelers in Bloodhoof Village seek a trophy quill to prove their cleverness and resolve. Bringing one to elders such as Harken Windtotem honors the hunter’s clan and shows the sharp senses needed to thrive on the plains.

faq.q: What is a Trophy Swoop Quill used for?
faq.answer: Trophy Swoop Quills prove hunting merit when you bring them to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village. The feathers show determination and sharp observation, and honor your standing among the local tauren.

faq.q: Where do Trophy Swoop Quills come from?
faq.answer: Trophy Swoop Quills come from common swoops, wiry swoops, and taloned swoops soaring across Mulgore’s rolling plains.

faq.q: Why are swoops considered difficult to hunt?
faq.answer: Harken Windtotem describes swoops as cunning birds that circle high above the grass and move quickly across the land. Sharp eyes help you spot them, and fleet footwork helps you run them down.

angles.text: As a tauren, hunting swoops and bringing home their quills tests patience and cleverness across Mulgore, honoring you and your clan.
As a hunter, tracking airborne prey across open plains tests your tracking, patience, and marksmanship.
